hunks.baseline: *I didn't think this through.*
hunks.sol: *I didn’t think this through.*

hunks.baseline: “Yeoreum, why do you keep trying to get out the door? Stay here and play with your big sis.”
hunks.sol: “Yeoreum, why do you keep trying to get out the door? Stay here and play with Sis.”

hunks.baseline: “Oh no, is Yeoreum mad? I’m sorry. Did Sis touch you too much? Okay, I’ll stay still, so play on the bed, all right?”
hunks.sol: “Oh no, is Yeoreum mad? I’m sorry. Did Sis pet you too much? Okay, I’ll leave you alone, so play on the bed, all right?”

hunks.baseline: This damn younger sister had absolutely no intention of letting him outside. Thanks to her, he had spent more than a day and a half trapped in Jin Hayeon’s room.
hunks.sol: This damn younger sister had absolutely no intention of letting him out. Thanks to her, he had spent more than a day and a half trapped in Jin Hayeon’s room.

hunks.baseline: *This gets me nowhere.*
hunks.sol: *This is getting me nowhere.*

hunks.baseline: Swept up by a sense of crisis, Hong Woojin attempted to escape.
hunks.sol: Gripped by a sense of urgency, Hong Woojin attempted to escape.

hunks.baseline: His first attempt was a failure. He scratched desperately at the door and even tried crying as loudly as he could, but Jin Hayeon didn’t react even once.
hunks.sol: His first attempt failed. He scratched desperately at the door and even yowled as loudly as he could, but Jin Hayeon didn’t react even once.

hunks.baseline: Without even putting on earphones, she simply continued solving problems with a fierce look in her eyes and swift movements of her hands.
hunks.sol: She wasn’t even wearing earphones. She simply sat at her desk, tearing through her workbook with fierce concentration.

hunks.baseline: He had seen it in the initial investigation report. Ever since middle school, she had routinely ranked first or second in her entire school and had earned countless awards in various academic competitions. It was hard to forget a record like that.
hunks.sol: He had seen it in the initial investigation report. Ever since middle school, she had routinely ranked first or second in her entire school and had earned countless awards in academic competitions. It was hard to forget a record like that.

hunks.baseline: Sitting in front of her desk, she possessed truly terrifying powers of concentration.
hunks.sol: Sitting at her desk, she displayed a truly terrifying level of concentration.

hunks.baseline: He continued trying to disrupt her studies somehow. He pawed at her feet without pause and kept acting cute.
hunks.sol: He continued trying everything he could to disrupt her studies. He pawed at her feet without pause and turned the cuteness up as high as it would go.

hunks.baseline: She pulled her feet up onto the chair and sat cross-legged, putting them completely out of reach of his tiny body.
hunks.sol: She pulled her feet onto the chair and sat cross-legged, putting them completely out of reach of his tiny body.

hunks.baseline: Since his plan to disrupt her studies had gone up in smoke, he had no choice but to bring out his final card. It would deal a serious blow to his human dignity, but this was no time to be picky.
hunks.sol: Since his plan to disrupt her studies had gone up in smoke, he had no choice but to play his final card. It would deal a serious blow to his human dignity, but this was no time to be picky.

hunks.baseline: *Fine. Since things have come to this, I might as well take care of it properly. Like a professional.*
hunks.sol: *Fine. Since things have come to this, I might as well do it properly. Like a professional.*

hunks.baseline: He rolled over and over.
hunks.sol: Roll, roll.

hunks.baseline: It had been five years since he started using Familiar magic. This was the first time he had ever fallen this far.
hunks.sol: It had been five years since he started using Familiar magic. This was the first time he had ever sunk this low.

hunks.baseline: He kept hypnotizing himself.
hunks.sol: He kept repeating the same words to himself.

hunks.baseline: By then, everything was over.
hunks.sol: By then, it was all over.

hunks.baseline: A duvet stained with urine and feces, and a kitten covered in filth.
hunks.sol: A duvet stained with urine and feces, and a kitten likewise covered in filth.

hunks.baseline: Jin Hayeon was startled and moved quickly. She pulled off the dirty duvet, then carefully grabbed the kitten by the scruff of its neck and lifted it up.
hunks.sol: Startled, Jin Hayeon sprang into action. She stripped off the dirty duvet, then carefully grabbed the kitten by the scruff and lifted it up.

hunks.baseline: Even though he was covered in filth and dangling from the hand of a girl who wasn’t even twenty, Hong Woojin was filled with joy.
hunks.sol: He might have been covered in filth and dangling from the hand of a girl who wasn’t even twenty, but Hong Woojin was filled with joy.

hunks.baseline: “That’s strange. Why does it look so happy?”
hunks.sol: “That’s strange. Why does it seem so happy?”

hunks.baseline: That was when the front door opened with the familiar electronic tones of someone entering the passcode.
hunks.sol: Just then, the front door opened to the familiar electronic tones of someone entering the passcode.

hunks.baseline: And then came the next thought.
hunks.sol: Then came their next thoughts.

hunks.baseline: It was the moment the last shred of Hong Woojin’s human dignity collapsed.
hunks.sol: It was the moment the last shred of Hong Woojin’s human dignity came crashing down.

hunks.baseline: “Yeah. I guess he had an accident while I was studying for a bit.”
hunks.sol: “Yeah. I guess he had an accident while I was studying.”

hunks.baseline: Since Hayeon had kept him in her room, petting and cuddling him nonstop, he had wracked his brain for a way to get out.
hunks.sol: Hayeon had kept him shut in her room, petting and cuddling him nonstop, so he’d put his brain to work trying to escape. That was all.

hunks.baseline: A cat.
No, there were two of them now, so I supposed I should call them by their names.
hunks.sol: The cat—no, there were two of them now, so I supposed I should call them by their names.

hunks.baseline: Whatever the case, Hayeon asked worriedly at the sound of Yeoreum’s feeble cry.
hunks.sol: Anyway, Yeoreum let out a feeble cry, and Hayeon asked worriedly, “He’s been listless for a while.”

hunks.baseline: “He’s been looking weak for a while.”
I couldn’t say for sure, but his self-loathing had to be something else.
hunks.sol: I couldn’t say for sure, but his self-loathing had to be off the charts.

hunks.baseline: “Don’t worry too much. Cats normally hate getting water on their bodies.”
hunks.sol: “Don’t worry too much. Cats hate getting wet, you know.”

hunks.baseline: They say a frog can die from a stone thrown without a second thought.
hunks.sol: They said a thoughtlessly thrown stone could kill a frog.

hunks.baseline: That was exactly what had happened here. Hayeon’s offhand remark turned into a blade and lodged itself in someone’s chest.
hunks.sol: This was exactly that kind of situation. Hayeon’s offhand remark turned into a dagger and plunged into someone’s heart.
Flinch.

hunks.baseline: The kitten trembled violently in silence, unable to even cry out.
hunks.sol: The kitten trembled violently in silence, unable even to cry out.

hunks.baseline: Meanwhile, the other one was having a wonderful time.
hunks.sol: Meanwhile, the other one was having the time of its life.

hunks.baseline: Hayeon gazed at the black cat with a face full of adoration as it repeatedly rubbed its face against my leg, making happy noises.
hunks.sol: The black cat made happy noises as it rubbed its face against my leg over and over, and Hayeon gazed at it with utter adoration.

hunks.baseline: “What? Then he might have a mother. You’re supposed to watch a kitten for about a day before bringing it home.”
hunks.sol: “What? Then his mother might be nearby. You’re supposed to watch a kitten for about a day before bringing it home.”

hunks.baseline: The black cat flinched.
hunks.sol: Flinch!

hunks.baseline: Its purring and attempts to act cute stopped dead. Without realizing it, Hayeon had scored two kills, and she smiled brightly.
hunks.sol: The purring and affectionate nuzzling stopped dead. Without realizing it, Hayeon had scored two kills, and she smiled brightly.

hunks.baseline: “There, there. You don’t have a mother, either. It’s okay. From today onward, Sis will be your mommy.”
hunks.sol: “There, there. You don’t have a mother, either. It’s okay. From today on, Sis will be your mommy.”

hunks.baseline: The black cat seemed torn between professional duty and the cheap shot at his mom, but soon accepted reality.
hunks.sol: The black cat seemed torn between professional duty and the insult to his mother, but soon accepted reality.

hunks.baseline: *That’s the hardship of being a working stiff.*
hunks.sol: *Such is the sorrow of the working stiff.*

hunks.baseline: “I don’t know. She went out because she had an important appointment.”
hunks.sol: “I don’t know. She went out for an important appointment.”

hunks.baseline: Mom had been leaving the house frequently these days. Now that she had some free time after quitting her job, was she finally looking for a life of her own?
hunks.sol: Mom had been leaving the house frequently these days. Now that she had some free time after quitting her job, was she finally finding a life of her own?

hunks.baseline: Sometimes she would sit there with an expression that looked as though she had something to say. Other times, she would jump whenever I suddenly spoke to her.
hunks.sol: Sometimes she would sit there looking as though she had something to say. Other times, she would jump whenever I suddenly spoke to her.

hunks.baseline: Something had definitely changed around Mom.
hunks.sol: Something had definitely changed in Mom’s life.

hunks.baseline: The person I loved and trusted most in this world was my mother. Just as always, all I could do was trust her and wait.
hunks.sol: My mother was the person I loved and trusted most in this world. As always, all I could do was trust her and wait.

hunks.baseline: Of course, listening to her and talking things over at the right time was also a child’s duty.
hunks.sol: Of course, sitting down with her and listening when the time was right was also part of being her son.

hunks.baseline: “What, you sound like you want me to leave.”
hunks.sol: “What? You sound like you want me to leave.”

hunks.baseline: My expression must have revealed my thoughts, because Hayeon hesitated.
hunks.sol: My expression must have revealed my thoughts, because Hayeon faltered.

hunks.baseline: “Don’t apologize. It makes me twice as pathetic.”
hunks.sol: “Don’t apologize. It makes me feel twice as pathetic.”

hunks.baseline: Two cats, one black and one white, began creeping toward me and circling around.
hunks.sol: The two cats, one black and one white, crept toward me and began circling.

hunks.baseline: The first thing I saw was the parking lot, where hundreds of cars were lined up.
hunks.sol: The first thing I saw was the parking lot, where hundreds of cars stood in rows.

hunks.baseline: My real purpose had been to check the vehicles.
hunks.sol: My real purpose had been to inspect the vehicles.

hunks.baseline: The result was nothing suspicious.
hunks.sol: Nothing had seemed suspicious.

hunks.baseline: *Then it has to be one of those houses.*
hunks.sol: *Then it has to be one of those apartments.*

hunks.baseline: That confirmed the watchers had made one of the recently traded apartments their base. I recalled the information I had obtained from the real-estate office once more.
hunks.sol: That confirmed the watchers had made one of the recently sold or leased apartments their base. I recalled the information I had obtained from the real-estate office.

hunks.baseline: Coincidentally, all three were positioned around our apartment, forming a sort of ring. They were ideal for surveillance, since their windows offered a view of the entrances to the buildings.
hunks.sol: Coincidentally, all three were positioned around our apartment, forming a ring. Their windows also overlooked the building entrances, making them ideal for surveillance.

hunks.baseline: It wouldn’t be strange for the watchers to be in any one of them.
hunks.sol: The watchers could have been in any one of them.

hunks.baseline: If I approached recklessly, I would lose them. To make a definite capture, I had no choice but to throw out equally substantial bait.
hunks.sol: If I approached recklessly, I would lose them. To make sure I caught them, I had no choice but to throw out some equally substantial bait.

hunks.baseline: *I think it’s time to begin.*
hunks.sol: *Time to get started.*

hunks.baseline: First, I drew all the curtains in the house. Even though it was the middle of the day, the living room had grown dim. I reached into my pocket.
hunks.sol: First, I drew every curtain in the house. Though it was the middle of the day, the living room grew dim. Standing in its center, I reached into my pocket.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, my hand closed around a lump of metal about half the size of my palm.
hunks.sol: At the same time, my hand closed around a lump of metal half the size of my palm.

hunks.baseline: I carefully swept through the house with the detection Equipment. After confirming that no mana was being detected inside, I took out my smartphone and called someone.
hunks.sol: I carefully swept the entire house with the detection Equipment. After confirming that there was no mana inside, I took out my smartphone and called someone.

hunks.baseline: The other person answered as the call connected.
hunks.sol: The call connected, and the other person answered.

hunks.baseline: I replied.
“It’s me, Jin Taekyung.”
hunks.sol: I replied, “It’s me, Jin Taekyung.”

hunks.baseline: The Security Team members, who had been sitting close together and writing their assessments, jumped in surprise.
hunks.sol: The Security Team members, who had been huddled together writing their statements, jumped in surprise.

hunks.baseline: Kim Junsu nodded at the team member who had let his voice trail off.
hunks.sol: Kim Junsu nodded at the team member who had trailed off.

hunks.baseline: “The target. This guy reeks to high heaven.”
hunks.sol: “The target. This bastard reeks of something rotten.”

hunks.baseline: “Yes. I got a bad feeling when he drew all the curtains as soon as the house was empty, and then he even used detection Equipment to inspect the inside.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. I knew something was off when he drew all the curtains the moment the house was empty. Then he even used detection Equipment to sweep the place.”

hunks.baseline: That wasn’t something an ordinary C-rank Hunter, especially one on vacation, would do.
hunks.sol: That wasn’t something an ordinary C-rank Hunter would do, especially while on vacation.

hunks.baseline: “Th-then?”
hunks.sol: “Th-then what?”

hunks.baseline: “The call was so short that it didn’t even last three minutes. But more than that, I could tell he was being extremely careful about how he addressed the other person.”
hunks.sol: “It was short—not even three minutes—but I could tell he was being extremely careful about how he addressed the other person.”

hunks.baseline: “That’s enough. We’ll report it up the chain and pull that bastard’s call records.”
hunks.sol: “That’s enough. We’ll report it up the chain and have them pull that bastard’s call records.”

hunks.baseline: “Right. And there was nothing else?”
hunks.sol: “Right. Was there anything else?”

hunks.baseline: “How could there be nothing else? Do you know what he said?”
hunks.sol: “Of course there was. Do you know what he said?”

hunks.baseline: He cleared his throat once. Then a low voice came from his mouth.
hunks.sol: Ahem. After clearing his throat, he lowered his voice.

hunks.baseline: At that moment, Kim Gwondong, who had been listening quietly, suddenly spoke.
hunks.sol: At that moment, Kim Gwondong, who had been listening quietly, spoke up.

hunks.baseline: “Junsu, didn’t that bastard say he had an item?”
hunks.sol: “Junsu, didn’t that bastard say he had some kind of item?”
